transport: PowerSync NDJSON stream from actual Convex export

results.name: PowerSync readiness and liveness are healthy
Actual export stream delivers only owner-authorized meeting projection
Viewer receives a separate read-only projection with no privileged fields
A committed child update reaches a new independently authenticated stream
Foreign actor and workspace claim substitutions return no rows
Client request parameters cannot override signed workspace claims
PowerSync rejects missing, expired, wrong audience and invalid signature credentials
Role promotion and demotion automatically replicate write capabilities without explicit rebuild
Upsert suspension and reactivation automatically delete and restore replicated views
Security disable automatically deletes projections for already issued credentials and denies Convex reads
Membership removal automatically deletes a restored actor projection

limitations: Local ES256 test signer; no external Clerk or Microsoft login flow
Direct protocol qualification; separate browser tests qualify actual SQLite SDK
Automatic invalidation covers the pilot exported setRole/upsert/remove/securityDisable paths only; other document/material ACL, identity changes and expiry paths still require release support
